participation.context: Defended the hurry of the kitchen, wrote the pause, and refused a second and a crust.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read old Capulet flat, and kept him among small orders.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Waited where nothing was written, and named what a pause can hold.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Laughed unasked, and was told not to hunt the laugh.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

relations.note: he finds the beat and states it
relations.quote: Give a man a pause and he'll fill it with a whole life.

story.body: You let Kemp keep the wait he had found, you wrote the one word, and you stopped the work before it became a promise.
